title: Sr Territory Manager, Eyecare
description:
**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

Deliver sales performance, brand KPIs, financial targets, marketing objectives, etc. in order to  

meet or exceed on those objectives.  

Create precall plan using SMART objectives and execute postcall evaluation in order to  

continuously improve sales performance. Effectively handle objections, misunderstandings,  

concerns and consistently gain logical and reasonable calls to action in order to close on every  

sales call.  

Proactively and continuously aspire to serve customer needs, customer expectations and  

challenges in order to build trusted customer relationships and to achieve winwin agreements  

between AbbVie and customers.  

Develop and execute a call plan that achieves set call metrics and optimizes coverage and  

frequency to key customers in order to maximize access and sales opportunities.  

Continuously build understanding on customer needs and expectations, territory market landscape,  

competitors, market segments/dynamics, accounts, disease, product, clinical and sales expertise  

and share this market intelligence information with infield team, brand team and sales manager to  

achieve alignment, to anticipate environmental changes and challenges and to optimize brand  

strategy and its execution.  

Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with health providers assigned and identify, develop and  

maintain disease state experts and speakers/advocates in order to maximize brand performance.

 **Qualifications**  

Any governmental and/or or legal mandatory certification requirements as by respective country’s  

laws and/or regulations (if applicable)  

Bachelor\'s degree, biological sciences, pharmacy, business related field, or equivalent.  

Proven track record of success in selling and solid presentation skills  

Demonstrates indepth scientific, therapeutic, product, and competitive knowledge and is  

recognized as an expert resource by all relevant stakeholders  

Strong business acumen and proficient use of business tools; possesses strategic and critical  

thinking capabilities  

Proactively identifies customer style / behavior and adapts quickly all aspects of selling approach  

Operates effectively in a matrix environment  

Proven track record of success in sales performance within respective therapeutic areas preferred  

Commercial pharmaceutical industry experiences such as physician/account based selling, training,  

managed health care or marketing preferred  

English language proficiency verbally and in writing preferred (for all non English speaking

 **Additional Information**  

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: ecommerce Category Manager
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and commercially driven eCommerce Category Manager to support our US based Client’s Merchants in managing day\-to\-day merchandising activities and driving sales, profitability, inventory health, and category growth.

The ideal candidate should have relevant experience in at least 3 of these 5 areas:

 E\-commerce

 Excel / Business Analytics

 Inventory \& Pricing

 Vendor Management

 US Market / US Client Experience

The candidate should be analytical, observant, proactive, and capable of supporting the Merchant in driving sales and profits for the company.

Key Responsibilities

 Support the Merchant in day\-to\-day operations including pricing, promotions, back orders, ABS inquiries, vendor management, marketing submissions, and PO placement

 Assist with sales forecasting, budgeting, inventory planning, and product assortment

 Monitor sales, pricing, inventory, and business performance to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities

 Support the management of vendors, product data, purchase orders, and promotional activities

 Analyze slow\-moving and excess inventory and support initiatives to improve inventory movement

 Prepare reports and maintain key Sales, Marketing, Inventory, Brand, and Pricing metrics

 Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Inventory teams for smooth execution

 Support the Merchant in identifying business opportunities and implementing solutions to drive growth and profitability category

Additional Requirements

 3–5 years of relevant experience in merchandising, e\-commerce, buying, business operations, category management, or a related field

 Knowledge of core merchandising systems and processes is an advantage  Experience working with cross\-functional teams

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities  Excellent English communication skills

 Highly organized with strong attention to detail

 Proactive approach with the ability to identify problems and recommend solutions

 Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

 Experience working with US clients or US e\-commerce/retail markets will be an added advantage

Preferred Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates coming from backgrounds such as: Associate Buyer \| Merchant Assistant \| Merchandising Executive \| E\-commerce Executive \| Category Executive \| Category Analyst \| Vendor Management Executive \| E\-commerce Operations Executive Candidates with a combination of E\-commerce \+ Excel/Analytics \+ Inventory/Pricing \+ Vendor Management \+ US Market exposure will be highly preferred.

Why Join Us?  Opportunity to work closely with the Merchant and gain exposure to buying, merchandising, e\-commerce, inventory, pricing, and business analytics

 Opportunity to work with US\-market business operations

 Cross\-functional exposure across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Logistics, and Operations

 Growth opportunity

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Social Media Manager & Video Editor
description:
**About the Role**

We are is looking for a creative, tech\-savvy Social Media Manager \& Video Editor to join our growing in\-house team in Sargasan.

This is a hands\-on creative role for someone who can **create high\-quality graphics, professional videos, short\-form reels, and engaging social media content** while using modern AI tools to make content creation faster, better, and more creative.

You will be responsible for managing company's social media presence across **Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and youtube**, creating content, editing videos, engaging with our audience, and helping build our online brand. You will be responsible for creating brand assets and outreach videos.

**This is NOT an agency role.** You will work exclusively on our Company's social media and content, giving you the opportunity to deeply understand our product, audience, brand, and industry.Apply with your best content created so far or with Portfolio.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage and grow company's social media accounts across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and youtube
* Create professional and engaging **social media posts, reels, short videos, animations, graphics, and other visual content**
* Edit videos for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms
* Create content from ideas, scripts, product features, screenshots, recordings, and raw footage, UGC content and editing
* Use **AI tools effectively** for video generation, editing, voiceovers, captions, graphics, scripts, images, and content creation
* Develop creative concepts and turn ideas into polished, high\-quality content
* Maintain a consistent brand style across all platforms
* Write or assist with captions, hooks, headlines, and social media copy
* Schedule and publish content
* Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement
* Respond to and engage with our audience professionally
* Track content performance and identify what types of content perform best
* Stay up to date with social media trends, short\-form video trends, AI tools, and content formats
* Work closely with our team to understand upcoming features, campaigns, announcements, and marketing initiatives

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience managing social media accounts professionally
* Strong **graphic design and visual content creation skills**
* Strong **video editing skills** with a good understanding of pacing, transitions, captions, music, hooks, and storytelling
* Experience creating **Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and other short\-form content**
* Comfortable using AI\-powered tools for content creation and video production
* Ability to learn and effectively use new AI platforms and creative tools
* Strong understanding of what makes content engaging on different social platforms
* Good English communication and writing skills
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail
* Ability to independently take an idea from **concept → creation → editing → publishing**
* Ability to create **high\-quality, professional content**, not just basic social media posts
* We are looking for someone who can **create**, not simply schedule posts.

**AI \& Creative Tools** We are particularly interested in candidates who actively use AI in their workflow.  
Experience with tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud, AI video generators, AI voice tools, image\-generation tools, or similar platforms** is a strong advantage.

You don't need to know every tool but you should be c**omfortable experimenting with AI and learning new platforms quickly.**

**Work Arrangement** The position is in\-person at our office in Sargasan, Gandhinagar.

**AGENCIES PLEASE DON'T APPLY.**

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of Social Media Management experience do you have?
* How many years of Video creation and editing experience do you have?
* Are you able to work from office at Sargasan, Gandhinagar?

Work Location: In person

title: Lead - Sales & Marketing
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Executive \- Closing**


**Prospecting and Lead Generation:**



Proactively identify and qualify leads in designated markets through high\-volume B2B and B2C sales calls.



Aggressively seek new business opportunities and expand the client network to rapidly achieve revenue targets.



Continuously drive urgency for repurchase and referrals, ensuring a strong and fast\-moving sales pipeline.


**Client Engagement and Relationship Management:**



Swiftly attend to customers, negotiate effectively, and close deals within defined timelines to meet month\-on\-month revenue goals.



Ensure immediate follow\-ups to maintain engagement and convert interest into sales without delay.



Proactively push for faster closures through regular meetings with channel partners, driving engagement and empanelment for increased business.


**Sales Process and Support:**



Work with a sense of urgency alongside the Team Lead to convert proposals into confirmed sales through quick and effective site visits.



Minimize decision delays by actively addressing customer concerns and ensuring rapid communication of product knowledge.



Drive fast\-tracked customer engagement, resolving queries immediately and ensuring smooth movement through the sales funnel.


**Industry Awareness:**



Keep abreast of relevant competitor details, including price movements, construction activity, key trends, and market dynamics.



Network effectively with peer teams and industry contacts to stay updated on key developments and potential business opportunities.



Liaise with various departments to gain deeper product knowledge and insights.


**Team Collaboration:**



Support peer teams in effective deal closure, ensuring all required documents (legal agreements, billing, credit, etc.) are in place and monitor collections for designated accounts.



Coordinate with departments (Customer Care, Sales \& Marketing, Projects, etc.) to ensure exceptional customer service and experience.


**Systems and Process Compliance:**



Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and share regular updates with the Team Lead and Area Sales Manager.



Ensure thorough adherence to SFDC and lead tracking mechanisms as required.



Comply with the highest standards of Sales Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), policies, and processes.


**Financial Management:**



Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and provide regular updates to the Segment Head.



Monitor collections for designated accounts and ensure timely payments.


**Strategic Sales Management:**



Drive the overall sales strategy for the region, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and AOP targets.



Analyze market trends to identify opportunities for growth and expansion.



Collaborate with project heads to set clear sales objectives and performance metrics to achieve the broader organizational objectives.


**Operational Oversight:**



Ensure all project sites within the cluster are running smoothly and efficiently as per the plan.



Ensure regular visits are conducted to each site to assess performance and provide guidance, wherever necessary.



Implement standardized processes across sites to enhance operational efficiency.



Oversee the performance of Channel Partners (CP) within the cluster, ensuring that regular engagement and meetings are conducted to drive business results.



Monitor CP performance metrics and facilitate improvements as necessary.


**New Business Development:**



Identify and pursue new business opportunities at each project site.



Leverage existing client relationships and market insights to generate leads.



Encourage project heads to actively participate in B2B and B2C sales initiatives.



Develop and implement go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies for new product launches, and work with the CRM team for creation of right pricing and offers.



Coordinate marketing discussions to determine the best channels for advertising.


**Stakeholder Liaison:**


* Liaise with internal and Key Stakeholders \- External:, including site engineers and CRM teams, to ensure seamless project execution and address any operational challenges.


* Establish effective communication channels to facilitate timely updates and feedback.


* Work collaboratively with various departments to optimize customer service and operational support.



Financial Performance Management


* Monitor topline performance across all projects within the cluster and provide regular updates to senior management.


* Analyze sales data to identify trends and undertake strategic decisions, to support the business.


* Adjust pricing strategies based on market conditions and competitive landscape.



Team Leadership and Development


* Lead, mentor, and support project heads and sales teams to achieve their targets.


* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and accountability



Compliance and Reporting

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and provide regular reports to management• Provide ongoing guidance to the team to ensure they are well\-equipped to meet business objectives.


* Ensure team engagement, motivation, and consistent drive towards achieving set targets.

title: CHIEF SALES & Marketing Officer
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Strategic Leadership**


* Develop and execute a comprehensive sales and marketing strategy aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.
* Lead and guide the heads of key functions, ensuring cohesive strategy implementation and performance.
* Participate in executive and strategic discussions to shape the company’s direction and goals.


**Revenue Growth**


* Drive strategies to increase cements and allied products sales, focusing on new business acquisition and customer retention.
* Implement dynamic sales plans based on market trends, customer needs, and competitive analysis.
* Oversee the acquisition of new customers and the implementation of retention initiatives.


**Brand Management**


* Oversee the development and execution of comprehensive brand strategies to maintain and enhance brand identity.
* Direct efforts in advertising, promotions, and public relations to ensure impactful campaigns.


**Market Analysis and Adaptation**


* Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities.
* Utilize data and market research to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.


**Compliance and Governance**


* Ensure all sales and marketing strategies comply with corporate governance policies and procedures.
* Actively mitigate legal risks associated with advertising, promotions, and sales practices.
* Maintain compliance with relevant laws and regulations across all sales and marketing activities.


**Technological Advancements**


* Maximize the efficacy of sales and marketing operations using technological tools like CRM systems.
* Implement technological advancements to streamline operations and improve efficiency.


**Performance and Budget Management**


* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for both sales and marketing.
* Utilize performance metrics to assess the overall effectiveness of strategies and campaigns.
* Develop and manage budgets, ensuring cost\-effective resource allocation to maximize ROI.


**Collaboration and Leadership**


* Foster collaboration between sales and marketing teams to ensure a unified approach.
* Mentor and develop the leadership team within the Sales and Marketing department.
* Promote a high\-performance culture focused on achieving business goals.


**Ethical Standards and Transparency**


* Champion ethical practices across all sales and marketing activities, ensuring transparency and integrity.
* Implement policies and procedures to prevent fraud and maintain high ethical standards.
* Foster a culture of compliance with ethical guidelines and promote accountability within the department.


**Internal Control and Risk Management**


* Establish robust internal controls to prevent leakages and ensure financial integrity in sales and marketing operations.
* Conduct regular audits and reviews to monitor compliance with internal controls and identify areas for improvement.
* Implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential risks associated with sales and marketing activities.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**


* Drive innovation in sales and marketing strategies and processes to stay ahead of industry trends and competitors.
* Encourage a culture of innovation within the department, supporting initiatives that enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Evaluate new technologies and methodologies to optimize sales and marketing operations and improve ROI.


**System Policy and procedures**


* Set clear guidelines for sales practices, customer interactions, data management, and the use of marketing materials.
* Ensure data security and set guidelines defining how customer data should be handled and protected.


**Financial Management**


* Oversee the budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning of sales and marketing initiatives.
* Analyse market trends, customer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to make informed decisions that will drive revenue growth and profitability.
* Set financial targets for the department and monitor performance against these targets to meet financial objectives of the organization.


**Internal Stakeholders**


* CEO
* CFO
* CHRO
* Chief Sales Officer
* National Head Technical Services
* National Head \- B2B
* Chief Brands \& Marketing
* Chief \- Solutions \& Products
* Head Pricing \& Margin
* Head \- Sales \& Market Development and PMO
* Head \- Analytics \& Demand Planning


**External Stakeholders**


* Sales Promoters
* Institutional Buyers
* Regulatory Bodies
* Trade Associations

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**


* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related field


**Work Experience (Range of years):**


* 20\+ years of experience in sales and marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.


**Industry Knowledge:**


* Experience in the cement or manufacturing industry is highly preferred. Demonstrated success in leading large, diverse teams and managing multiple functions.
